experiment: fast adaptation on synthetic meta-regression task families

protocol.gaussian_scale: each task standardised with its full-data mean and spread (256 extra points of the task); never with the support-estimated spread
protocol.count: y ~ Poisson(exposure * exp(offset + 0.7 f(x))), exposure in [0.5, 4]
protocol.metric: prequential NLL of the next point (nats) and RMSE of the predictive mean, by support size; summary = mean over support sizes 1..T-1
